result.summary: Found 2 issues: a critical content bug showing an untranslated localization key as a section title, and a major layout issue with a truncated restaurant name.

issues.description: Section heading displays the raw localization/i18n key 'home_feed.popular_title' instead of human-readable text like 'Popular'.
issues.suggestion: Resolve the translation string so the correct localized title is shown to users.

issues.description: Restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' is truncated/cut off under the Fastest near you carousel card.
issues.suggestion: Allow the title to wrap to two lines, use a smaller font, or ensure adequate width so the full name is visible.
